claim: On a 4x CMP 170HX rig at Gen2 x4, the measured PCIe transfer rate is 800 MB/s at Gen1 and 1.6 GB/s at Gen2.
stance_target: the fabric ceiling used in cc-2's arithmetic: a Gen2 x4 link on this hardware tops out near 1.6 GB/s, so a 5-rank ring all-reduce cannot exceed ~1.6 GB/s busbw and ~1.0 GB/s algbw
scope_conditions: 4x CMP 170HX (GA100, 70 SM, 64 GB each, 150 W), PCIe Gen2 x4, no NVLink, cards on a single x16-to-4x4 M2 bifurcation adapter
quoted_support: I personally don't see an issue with x4 PCIE - the transfer rate is 800MB/s at Gen 1 and 1.6GB/s at Gen 2.

claim: The same rig serves DeepSeek V4-Flash 0731 Q4_K_XL at ~29 tok/s generation and ~450 tok/s prefill on 4 cards at 1M context, with layer-split pipeline parallelism and no tensor parallelism.
stance_target: the practical serving envelope of a 4-card Gen2 x4 box, useful as a sanity check on the report's throughput band
scope_conditions: 4x CMP 170HX at Gen2 x4, llama.cpp -sm layer, f16 KV

claim: The report contains no NCCL or all-reduce measurement, so it bounds the link rate but does not settle NCCL's collective efficiency at 5 ranks.
stance_target: the gap cc-2 is trying to fill
quoted_support: I personally don't see an issue with x4 PCIE - the transfer rate is 800MB/s at Gen 1 and 1.6GB/s at Gen 2.
